id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multi-master single-channel shared serial bus; multidrop wired-AND with bitwise IDENTIFIER arbitration. The M_CAN controller is one node on this bus, attached via external transceiver. Internally exposes Host CPU register interface + external Message RAM interface + optional DMU + TSU + Extension interfaces.

supported_topologies.name: Linear bus (typical automotive)
supported_topologies.description: All CAN nodes tap onto a single twisted-pair. CAN FD enables faster data phase on the same wire.

supported_topologies.name: Optical fibre
supported_topologies.description: Physical layer optional; CAN FD frame format unchanged.

supported_topologies.name: Mixed Classical + CAN FD network
supported_topologies.description: Coexist if FD nodes never transmit FD frames while Classical nodes active.

supported_topologies.name: Multiple M_CANs sharing one Message RAM
supported_topologies.description: Generic Master Interface arbitration supports this.

supported_topologies.name: Time-Triggered CAN (TTCAN, ISO 11898-4)
supported_topologies.description: Use CCCR.DAR = 1; software runs schedule above M_CAN.

master_slave_role_summary.description: A unit that is not transmitter and the bus is not idle.
Normal operation; CAN FD ESI = dominant.
Receives + sends ACK; does NOT send error/data/remote/overload frames.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge) on the CAN bus. Inside the M_CAN, the Generic Master Interface arbitrates Tx Handler vs Rx Handler accesses to the external Message RAM.

ordering_guarantees.single_bus: All nodes simultaneously see the same bus value.
ordering_guarantees.tx_queue: Tx Queue transmits by lowest Message ID.
ordering_guarantees.rx_fifo: Rx FIFO writes in arrival order; Get Index advanced by host via FIFO Acknowledge.
ordering_guarantees.rx_buffer: Dedicated Rx Buffer locked by New Data flag.

slave_classification.data_producer: Any node may transmit DATA FRAMEs.
slave_classification.data_consumer: Any node may apply acceptance filtering.
slave_classification.M_CAN_as_Host_slave: Generic Slave Interface presents 512-byte register space.
slave_classification.M_CAN_as_Master: Generic Master Interface initiates 32-bit Message RAM access.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: Section 1 Overview — block diagram + dual clock domains.
Section 2.4 Message RAM — section partitioning + elements.

wake_up_topology.wake_up_trigger: External clock controller deasserts m_can_clkstop_req (or CPU clears CCCR.CSR).
wake_up_topology.wake_up_message: CAN FD itself does not define a wake-up identifier. Partial networking via ISO 11898-6 transceiver handles wake-up at the physical layer.
wake_up_topology.post_wake_sync: After clocks restart, M_CAN clears m_can_clkstop_ack + CCCR.CSA; CPU clears CCCR.INIT; BSP waits for 11 consecutive recessive bits.

two_clock_domains: Host clock domain — Tx Handler, Rx Handler, Generic Slave, Generic Master, RAM Watchdog.
CAN clock domain — CAN Core, BSP, BTL.
M_CAN_block_topology.interrupt_and_timestamp_block: 16-bit CAN-bit-time counter; routes IR to two CPU lines.
M_CAN_block_topology.extension_interface_block: Routes all IR flags + status/control to external interrupt unit.
